issue_context.title: [Trimming] Identity
issue_context.body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [X] I have searched the existing issues

### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe the problem.

Identity should run in a trimmed app.

### Describe the solution you'd like

Shipping projects under https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/tree/main/src/Identity need to add support for trimming.

See https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/main/docs/Trimming.md for instructions

### Additional context

_No response_
comments:

If we later determine, that the issue has no community involvement, or it's very rare and low-impact issue, we will close it - so that the team can focus on more important and high impact issues.
